newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA BANK SEES HEX INDEX RISING 11 PCT IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA BANK SEES HEX INDEX RISING 11 PCT IN 1997.

text.p: Aktia Bank said in a forecast on Tuesday it expected the Helsinki bourse HEX general share index to rise 11 percent in calendar 1997, and that the stock market return over the next 12 months would be eight percent.
"1997 will be another good year on the Helsinki stock exchange," Aktia said in a statement, adding, however, that the market's second-quarter performance would be in the red.
Dividends would account for 2.5 percent of the expected eight percent return on the HEX index in the coming 12 months, Aktia said.
